name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Looks like your search is going smoothly... How many have you found?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "W-Wait, that's incredible... These aren't things you can easily find..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Uh, it was actually pretty easy, though..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And the ritual? Can you do it now?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's not a problem. Because the final piece..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Uh, why'd you have to drag that out?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message:
"......
Could you lend me those four?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Thank you. Now that the five OOPArts have been brought together..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Is it me, or does this thing feel even weirder now?"

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It's a sign that the preparations to summon the higher being are complete."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The higher being. I don't know if it will truly appear, or if it even exists at all."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "But *this* is undeniably real—an object that gives off an anomalous aura, an OOPArt."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "So something should happen if you perform the ritual."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "If you're interested, I'll teach you how."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Otherwise, I'd like you to hand it over. I'll add it to my collection."
